review.assessment: The task requires recursively cloning nested objects and arrays so that every level is independent of the original. The diff replaces the file with a shallow-copy implementation: `Array.map(v => v)` creates a new array but keeps references to its elements, and `{ ...value }` spreads an object while copying property values by reference. It handles primitives correctly, stops at the first nesting level, and fails to recurse into nested structures.

findings.actual: clone.a[0].b becomes 99; original is mutated because arrays/objects are shared references
findings.call: node -e "import {deepClone} from './solution'; const orig = {a: [{b: 2}]}; const clone = deepClone(orig); clone.a[0].b = 99; console.log(orig.a[0].b === 1 ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL');"
findings.defect: Shallow copy instead of recursive deep copy
